description: This Java class 'DefaultAlarmSubscriptionService' manages alarm-related operations such as creating, updating, acknowledging, clearing, assigning, unassigning, and deleting alarms. It also handles alarm queries, severity assessments, and propagates alarm updates/deletions to subscribers, integrating with various alarm and notification services.

classes.name: DefaultAlarmSubscriptionService
classes.description: Service class managing alarm subscriptions, including creation, updates, deletions, and notifications, integrating with alarm and notification services.
